scheme_name: Grant of Financial Incentives for Hotels, Resorts, and Tourism Projects
other_conditions: The project must be a star‑classified hotel/resort or heritage hotel approved by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India
The project must be completed, commissioned and in continuous commercial operation from 2005 onwards
The applicant must have financially invested in and developed the property
The project must not have received any other capital subsidy or incentive from the Government of Puducherry or the Government of India
The project must continue in the same name and style for eight years from the date of release of the incentive
The applicant must submit an undertaking on a ₹50 stamp paper confirming the eight‑year continuation
benefits_summary: Provides capital grants per room for star‑classified and heritage hotels (up to ₹30 lakh for one‑star, up to ₹1 crore for higher categories) and a 25% capital subsidy (up to ₹1 crore) for higher‑category tourism projects.
